defects_closed.summary: Live provisional caption row sheared across the stage/transcript split at widths >= 900px with a long provisional caption.
contract_refs: 9.4 rank 3/5 (supporting content must not collide with the document surface)
defects_closed.review_attributed_cause: #island is a direct child of #document-surface with no grid-row/grid-column in the >=900px media block.
defects_closed.measured_actual_cause: #island is a FLEX child of #stage-pane (runtime parent chain: island -> stage-pane -> document-surface -> workspace -> app). With flex:none and the default min-width:auto it could not shrink, measuring 902.4px wide at x=-133.7 inside a 635px stage, overflowing both edges and forcing stage overflowX=150.

fix.change: flex:none -> flex:0 1 auto with align-self:stretch, min-inline-size:0, max-inline-size:100%; .island__text gains flex:0 1 auto and min-inline-size:0 so its already-declared ellipsis can engage.

defects_closed.summary: #btn-review rendered as a blank 44x44 control at <= 420px: its only visible child was hidden by media query and the styled .review-btn__icon node did not exist.

fix.change: Added check, the node public/style.css:1233 has always targeted. Resolves the review's residual risk #4 (dead selector).

defects_closed.summary: Action card text column crushed at the narrow floor: title and Korean description fragmented while the command group kept its full intrinsic width.
contract_refs: 9.13 (a real capability must be legible where the action lives)
defects_closed.review_attributed_cause: .action-card__btn label truncation from missing min-inline-size / text-overflow.
defects_closed.measured_actual_cause: Button labels always fit (overflowX=0 in RED and GREEN). The failure was a share-of-width collapse: .action-card__actions is flex-shrink:0 in a non-wrapping row, so the text column was squeezed to 81.4px of 254px (textShare=0.3204) at 320 and 0.4414 at 375. The two 'unlabeled siblings' were the same commands at opacity 0.45 in :disabled state.

fix.change: Added flex-wrap:wrap so the command group takes its own row; text column gains flex:1 1 auto and min-inline-size:0 to claim the full measure.
